description: Side-by-side statistics for several Finnish postal areas, with national benchmarks and percentiles. Accepts names or codes. Free callers are served only the FIRST TWO areas — the API truncates silently, and this tool reports the dropped ones in `locked`. If areas were dropped, say so; do not present a two-area answer as if it covered everything asked for. A null value or percentile is suppressed or unpublished for that area and year (small-area confidentiality), not zero; only the areas named in `locked` are paywalled.

places.description: Postal area names or 5-digit codes, 2 to 12 of them.

year.description: Statistics year; defaults to the newest.

name: compare_areas
title: Compare Finnish postal areas
